info.title: Cat Füd API
info.description:
The Cat Füd API: a shared pet-food catalogue (brand ladder, products, barcodes, advisories) plus each user's private pets, pantry, ratings and meal history.

Authenticate with `POST /register` or `POST /login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Catalogue reads are scoped to the caller's region and
to what they may see: approved products, plus their own pending contributions. Staff (moderator, admin) see more fields.

get.summary:
Public Advisories that may relate to what is in the user's pantry (matches limited to pantry products).
`?all=1` lists every advisory with all of its matches. Every item is attributed to its source

put.summary: The user's own decision about one match: new | confirmed | dismissed, with an optional note. The advisory is untouched

get.summary: The user's own inventory only. ?status=low|out|stocked and ?form=wet|dry filter

post.summary:
Add a product to the user's inventory by product_id or by a scanned/typed code.
If it is already there, the quantity is added to (one row per user per product)

message.const: Product not found. Look it up or add it first.

post.summary: Record what was offered. The outcome can be sent now or filled in afterwards with PATCH

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Every word must match brand, name, line or the brand path and its aliases.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: wet, dry or freeze-dried; omit for everything.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: Limit to a brand-tree node and everything beneath it.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Add a product that the scan lookup could not find. The creator is recorded as provenance

message.const: A product with that barcode already exists.

get.summary:
Look up a product by whatever the scanner (or the user's fingers) produced: its primary barcode or any extra
pack barcode. Found: 200. Valid code but unknown product: 404 with `gtin`, so the app can offer "add it".
Not a valid barcode: 422
The facet vocabulary (texture, medium, life stage, diet) grouped for the filter and edit screens

Browse the brand tree one level at a time: ?parent= (omit for the top). Only branches that hold products are
listed, with a count that honours the same ?form= and ?barcode=missing filters the search uses

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: The parent node to list the children of; omit for the top level.

patch.summary: Rename, re-kind, re-species or move a brand-tree node. A rename keeps the old name as an alias

post.summary: Fold one node into another. Products, lines and barcodes move across; the old names become aliases

get.summary:
The choices for one rung of the brand-ladder picker. ?path=Purina > Pro Plan returns what can follow it: nodes that
already exist (even with no products yet) plus the region's curated ladder (App\Support\BrandCatalogue). ?species=cat hides names sold only for other species.
Each choice carries a logo URL when public/images/brands/{slug}.png|svg|jpg|webp exists

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The ladder chosen so far, rungs separated by `>` (e.g. `Purina > Pro Plan`); omit for the top level.

parameters.name: species
parameters.description: Hide names sold only for other species (e.g. `cat`).

get.summary: Progress for the seed -> wire-up -> audit pass
One product with any Public Advisories that may relate to it

patch.summary:
Correct a catalogue record during the audit pass. `path` ("Purina > Pro Plan > Complete Essentials") moves the
product within the brand tree; `tags` replaces its facet tags. The primary barcode is changed only through
attachBarcode. Pilot note: any signed-in user can edit the shared catalogue; real roles are a later question

examples: Only a moderator can change the public catalogue.

get.summary: Every recipe/label on record for a product, newest first

put.summary:
Wire a scanned barcode to a product. A product with no barcode gets it as its primary barcode; a product that
already has one gets this as an extra pack barcode (single can, multipack, case). 409 if the code is already
on a product (the response names it, so the app can say so)

enum: That barcode is already on this product.
That barcode already belongs to another product.

examples: Only a moderator can add a barcode to the public catalogue.

post.summary: One rating per pet per product: posting again replaces the earlier one

get.summary:
GET /pets/{id}/suggestions?shuffle=1&exclude[]=3&exclude[]=7&seed=42&form=wet
The pick and the evidence behind it. `exclude` = products the user already passed on; `seed` makes shuffle repeatable

pack_label.description: For an extra barcode on a product that already has one: "24-can case".

into.description: The node that absorbs this one.

gtin.description: UPC-A, EAN-13, EAN-8 or GTIN-14, with a valid check digit.

path.description: The brand ladder, rungs separated by `>`. Users must pick existing rungs; anything else is kept as a request.

nutrition.description: Label values as printed, keyed by field (e.g. `crude_protein_min_pct`).

tags.description: Facet tags as `group:slug` (texture, medium, life_stage, diet).

name.description: Renaming keeps the old name as an alias.

parent_id.description: Move under another node; `null` makes it a top-level node.

species.description: Species this is sold for (`cat`, `dog`); `null` or empty means all.

path.description: Move the product within the brand tree (`Purina > Pro Plan > Prime Plus`).

title_as_listed.description: The name exactly as a retailer or package prints it.

audit_status.description: Staff only; ignored for everyone else.

formula_change.description: When the name, ingredients or nutrition change: `correction` fixes the recipe on file, `new_version` keeps the old one as history.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
